title: ZIKV NS3 Helicase Protein Purification Protocol
author: korvus.wang
materials: Nickel affinity resin Ni Sepharose 6 FF
Corrected ELN mistake Corrected guideline construct name mistake

steps.title: Cell Lysis and Clarification
steps.instruction: Prepare the cell lysate and remove insoluble debris.

substeps.instruction: Thaw and resuspend the pellet in ~7mL of lysis buffer per g of pellet.
Stir gently with a magnetic stir bar at Room temperature for 00:30:00 to allow lysozyme and bezonase to break down cell components.
Lyse by sonication (00:00:04 On, 00:00:12 Off) for a total 'on' time of 00:07:00 at 50% amplitude, ensuring the pellet remains at 4 °C to prevent overheating.
Centrifuge the lysed cells at 38,000 x g for 1 hour at 4 °C and collect the supernatant in a bottle at 4 °C.

steps.title: IMAC Column Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the Nickel affinity resin for protein extraction.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 5 mL Nickel affinity resin (Ni Sepharose 6 FF - Cytiva) into a gravity flow column.
Equilibrate the resin by rinsing first with ~10 CV distilled water, then ~10 CV binding buffer.

steps.title: Protein Binding and Extraction
steps.instruction: Bind the target protein to the resin and perform initial washes.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the equilibrated resin with binding buffer and add to the supernatant bottle.
Incubate the resin with the supernatant for 00:10:00 while rotating or mixing gently at 4 °C.
Load the resin/supernatant mix back onto the gravity flow column, retaining the flow through (FT) separately for SDS-PAGE analysis.
Wash the column with 10 CV of base buffer, followed by 10 CV of wash buffer twice, allowing the buffer to pass through completely between washes. Collect washes separately.

steps.title: Protein Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the target protein from the IMAC column.

substeps.instruction: Elute the protein with 1.5 CV of elution buffer.
Repeat the elution step one more time to collect a total of 2 separate elution fractions.

steps.title: IMAC Analysis and Resin Wash
steps.instruction: Verify protein presence and clean the resin.

substeps.instruction: Run SDS-PAGE of all samples from total lysis supernatant to final elution, staining with Coomassie Blue to identify fractions containing the target protein (expected MW 76.716 kDa).
Wash rIMAC resin with 2 CV wash buffer 1 to remove remaining target protein; collect FT and wash samples for SDS-PAGE characterization.

steps.title: Sample Concentration for SEC
steps.instruction: Concentrate the IMAC fractions for size exclusion chromatography.

substeps.instruction: Concentrate the rIMAC fractions containing the target protein to a final volume of under 1 mL using 30,000 MWCO spin concentrators.
Centrifuge the sample at 17,200 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C to remove solid aggregates.
Immediately draw up the supernatant with a 1mL syringe and a blunt-tip fill needle without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Size Exclusion Chromatography (SEC)
steps.instruction: Purify the protein further using gel filtration.

substeps.instruction: Inject the sample onto a 2mL sample loop of the AKTA Pure system.
Run the sample through a HiLoad 16/60 Superdex 200 pg gel filtration column at 1mL/min in gel filtration buffer, collecting 1mL aliquots.

steps.title: Final Concentration and Storage
steps.instruction: Concentrate the purified protein and store at low temperature.

substeps.instruction: Concentrate the final sample using Vivaspin 30kDa MWCO concentrators to a final concentration of approximately 20 mg/mL.
Aliquot the protein into appropriate volumes to minimize freeze/thaw cycles.
Flash-freeze in liquid nitrogen and store at -80 °C.
